set.body: Found by UI-G0 (2026-09-18): FixationImportError and the other io import/export and EyeLink error families have no diagnostic codes (listed as not catalogued in docs/DIAGNOSTICS.md), so a consumer cannot turn a CSV file-level failure into a coded, source-linked diagnostic. Add an io diagnostic catalog in the same shape as CodecDiagnosticCatalog, with record/line source links, and extend the missing-family walk to io.
set.title: Diagnostics for io import, export and EyeLink errors
